ideas.pitch: An AI-powered digital twin platform to predict thermal degradation and tensile strength of recycled polyethylene blends based on processing temperatures and molecular weight distributions.
ideas.title: PolymerFlow Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core materials science theme of the IIT Madras Amalgam symposium by directly solving industrial recycling and property prediction problems.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline that predicts the carbon footprint and biodegradability rates of newly synthesized bio-polymers from their chemical SMILES strings.
ideas.title: GreenPolymer LCA Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines materials engineering property prediction with sustainability metrics, which appeals directly to academic judges from IITs and IISc.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web application combining a machine learning model for polymer melt viscosity estimation with real-time sensor simulation feeds for extrusion manufacturing.
ideas.title: ViscoPredict IoT Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live interactive demo showcasing predictive capabilities rather than static model metrics, following winning hackathon patterns.

ideas.pitch: A web-based interactive tool allowing materials engineers to input filler concentration and polymer matrix types to instantly predict electrical conductivity and glass transition temperature.
ideas.title: NanoComposite Property Explorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an immediately usable domain-specific tool for metallurgical and materials engineering researchers attending the national symposium.

ideas.pitch: An image classification and property correlation model that takes microscopy images of polymer films and predicts structural tear resistance and crystallinity index.
ideas.title: PolymerDefect Vision AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges the gap between computer vision and physical materials characterization, a unique intersection for a metallurgical festival hackathon.
